objective.name: projection_definition
objective.description: Defines the deterministic rules used to select, filter, order, and limit continuity messages when building a projected cognitive context.

functional._include_kinds_note: Optional. Restricts the projection to messages whose kind belongs to the provided set.
functional._exclude_kinds_note: Optional. Excludes messages whose kind belongs to the provided set.
functional._from_note: Optional. Restricts the projection to messages originating from the specified source or sources.
functional._to_note: Optional. Restricts the projection to messages addressed to the specified destination or destinations.
functional._min_seq_note: Optional. Lowest message sequence number eligible for inclusion.
functional._max_seq_note: Optional. Highest message sequence number eligible for inclusion.
functional._correlation_note: Optional. Restricts the projection to messages matching the specified correlation dimensions.
functional._message_ids_note: Optional. Explicit set of message identifiers to include.
functional._limit_note: Optional. Maximum number of messages selected by the projection.
functional._selection_note: Optional. Deterministic selection strategy applied after filtering. Defaults to all when absent.
functional._include_parent_note: Optional. Indicates whether explicitly related parent-continuity messages may be included.
functional._include_children_note: Optional. Indicates whether explicitly related child-continuity messages may be included.
functional._continuity_ids_note: Optional. Explicit additional continuity identifiers whose messages may participate in the projection.
functional._budget_note: Optional. Maximum projection budget according to the convention used by the consuming LLM or wrapper.
